## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Given any audit entry, a query returns its full causal chain back to the...

The system SHALL ensure that given any audit entry, a query returns its full causal chain back to the originating event or human request.

#### Scenario: Given any audit entry, a query returns its full causal chain back to the...

WHEN `causal-trace-ids` is implemented
THEN Given any audit entry, a query returns its full causal chain back to the originating event or human request.

### Requirement: Every audit entry, event, approval, handoff, and phase record written after...

The system SHALL ensure that every audit entry, event, approval, handoff, and phase record written after the change carries a non-empty on_behalf_of chain ending in a human principal.

#### Scenario: Every audit entry, event, approval, handoff, and phase record written after...

WHEN `causal-trace-ids` is implemented
THEN Every audit entry, event, approval, handoff, and phase record written after the change carries a non-empty on_behalf_of chain ending in a human principal.

### Requirement: Events caused by an agent's own action are identifiable as echoes by...

The system SHALL ensure that events caused by an agent's own action are identifiable as echoes by causation ID, and a loop guard rejects causal chains exceeding the configured hop count.

#### Scenario: Events caused by an agent's own action are identifiable as echoes by...

WHEN `causal-trace-ids` is implemented
THEN Events caused by an agent's own action are identifiable as echoes by causation ID, and a loop guard rejects causal chains exceeding the configured hop count.

### Requirement: In solo mode the chain resolves to the sole repository principal and no new...

The system SHALL ensure that in solo mode the chain resolves to the sole repository principal and no new prompts appear.

#### Scenario: In solo mode the chain resolves to the sole repository principal and no new...

WHEN `causal-trace-ids` is implemented
THEN In solo mode the chain resolves to the sole repository principal and no new prompts appear.
